component.name: NewNyth
component.summary: Configure the Roccat Nyth gaming mouse

description.p: NewNyth is a modern Linux driver suite for the Roccat Nyth. The configuration GUI edits CPI levels, polling rate, lighting, Easy-Shift button layouts and per-button actions, while the background daemon adds window-based profile auto-switching on Wayland and a D-Bus interface for automation.
